run_semantic_id_tutorial: run the habitat sim semantic ID tutorial to render RGB and semantic camera observations
create_simulator_configuration: create a habitat sim configuration with RGB and semantic camera sensor specs
place_agent_in_scene: place an agent at a specific position and rotation in the habitat sim scene
render_sensor_observations: render and optionally display RGB and semantic camera observations from the simulator
set_object_semantic_ids: set semantic IDs on rigid objects and their visual scene nodes in habitat sim
